scope: CIR-only candidate availability; no wrongness selector, P/M pruning, FP replacement, mu/R fit, EKF run or parameter optimization
mapping_boundary: Candidate generation does not consume a distance prior. E0 native diagnostic semantics and any remaining baseline limitation must be stated by the parent run contract. No flat r(n)+/-half-step assumption is used, and no E1-02/E2 permission follows from this candidate-only execution.

dynamic.raw_full: BLOCK_C/FULL_RF/H_{route}_aB_m0.npy at exact original pose_id, TX0
dynamic.raw_los: BLOCK_C/H_LoS_{route}_aB_m0.npy at the same exact pose_id, TX0
dynamic.bias_metadata: B0, exposed seed10 pose set; neither bias nor seed enters generator

static_g4.statistical_role: Secondary static controls, separate from the primary dynamic denominator; 24 conditions are not 24 independent environments.

corpus.primary_comparison: TWO_PORT_UNION candidate recall on valid >=2tap reference errors in dynamic Full; STRONGEST_ONLY is the paired availability ablation. Do not pool G4 into the dynamic primary score.
corpus.sampling: All locked IDs; no hotspots, random packet splits or post-hoc exclusions.

fixed_generator.noise_floor_definition: v_C=6*v_H; A_noise=max(3*sqrt(v_C),sqrt(v_C*ln(2*1028/0.001))). For this declared clean corpus v_H=0. The 3-sigma minimum is not a 99.7% claim, and the clean trial establishes no noisy detectability.
fixed_generator.raw_detector: Unchanged source receiver: strongest RX peak, earliest port tie; first amplitude crossing >=0.30 of that strongest peak.
fixed_generator.local_peak: Interior maximal plateau strictly above both immediate neighboring samples; earliest plateau index. Boundary plateaus strictly above their sole neighbor are logged with BOUNDARY_PEAK_NOT_CANDIDATE, no candidates/groups; a constant full-array plateau is not a local peak. Valid raw fallback remains.
fixed_generator.prominence: For each peak, extend left/right until a higher sample or boundary; subtract the larger of the two side minima from peak magnitude. Exact equal side minima use the nearest index to the peak.
fixed_generator.local_edge_segment: Walk left from the earliest peak index along nondecreasing magnitudes to the nearest local minimum; this monotone rising segment is separate from the wider prominence basin. If its minimum is not below 0.30*peak, mark unresolved and generate no edge.
fixed_generator.significant_peak: peak>=max(A_noise,A_numeric) AND prominence>=max(A_noise,0.06*global_peak). A_numeric=64*eps_float64*global_peak for nonzero finite waveform.
fixed_generator.candidate_generation: For each significant resolved lobe, use its local first 30%-amplitude crossing e, then {e-1,e,e+1} inside the rising segment through the peak. Retain a tap only if its generating RX magnitude is >=max(A_noise,A_numeric,0.15*local_peak). No GT/LoS/prior/history inputs.
fixed_generator.lobe_group: Only significant resolved lobes with >=1 supported candidate, and ports active in that mode. Local valleys: walk left from earliest plateau peak while next-left<=current magnitude; walk right from last plateau index while next-right<=current magnitude. Group open intervals (left_local_valley,right_local_valley) by strictly positive overlap, with transitive components. Touching at one valley never merges. Number components by the minimum (left,right,rx,peak) tuple of each component, ascending.
fixed_generator.two_port_null_rule: One supported RX is sufficient; no minimum power on both ports.
fixed_generator.duplicate_taps: For valid raw frames, union candidate tap IDs retaining all supporting RX/lobe IDs and add original n0 as fallback if absent. For invalid raw frames candidate lists are EMPTY; original finite zero-signal tap/rx/range/s fields remain separate raw metadata. Nonfinite CIR has raw tap/rx=None and explicit invalid status.
fixed_generator.overflow: Count every distinct tap ID INCLUDING valid raw fallback; all candidates logged and no truncation. A >64 pool is marked overflow and unusable for primary usable-candidate recall.
fixed_generator.no_signal: Zero/nonfinite/invalid-denominator original sample cannot create a usable pool. Preserve original raw fields for audit; do not fabricate a candidate or count zero signal as a correct observation.
fixed_generator.search: Exactly one generator. The 27-setting E2 family is not run or selected here. If this fixed generator fails, preserve the failure; any redesign requires a new version/contract.
fixed_generator.global_peak: max(abs(CIR)) across BOTH RX ports, using the same normalization in STRONGEST_ONLY and TWO_PORT_UNION

reference_and_denominators.reference: Original receiver on clean Native-LoS from same locked pose or G4 condition; evaluator only
reference_and_denominators.reference_valid: Finite clean native CIR, positive peak above numeric floor, finite selected s/range and positive two-port denominator; one polarization null allowed. This is exact-clean arithmetic support, not physical device sensitivity.
reference_and_denominators.raw_valid: The same validity definition on the current waveform; original zero-CIR detected=True does not override invalid s/denominator.
reference_and_denominators.unknown_reference: not reference_valid; preserve in all-input and output-availability denominators
reference_and_denominators.original_invalid: reference_valid AND not raw_valid; report separately, do not turn an arbitrary invalid raw tap into a wrong-reference detection label
reference_and_denominators.reference_in_all_pool: nL appears in distinct tap IDs including raw fallback
reference_and_denominators.reference_in_supported_pool: nL has at least one actual supporting lobe record, not only the fallback role
reference_and_denominators.reference_in_usable_pool: reference_in_supported_pool AND no overflow AND raw_valid; this is the primary candidate-availability success event for large errors
reference_and_denominators.normal_preservation: For valid original frames, n0 is retained in the candidate pool exactly. For invalid frames, preserve only raw metadata and require no candidates. No replacement is performed, so this is a construction check rather than selective-correction false-positive performance.

cluster_accounting.dynamic_error_episode: Within each route and waveform, maximal consecutive large-error rows; break when the label is not large, original pose_id is not prior+1, or elapsed timestamp exceeds 0.4s. Episode IDs are evaluator-only.
cluster_accounting.static_cluster: Coordinate ID; report four yaws together and all raw conditions individually
cluster_accounting.inference: Descriptive packet/episode/coordinate counts only. No IID packet CI, population safety probability or claim of independent RF environments.

observed_gate_proposal.primary: Dynamic Full TWO_PORT_UNION usable candidate recall among >=2tap errors >=0.95, with all route denominators disclosed.
observed_gate_proposal.stratified_guard: Every route with a nonzero large-error denominator must also meet >=0.95; otherwise report NOT_SUPPORTED_STRATIFIED and keep E2 GO false. A zero denominator is NOT_TESTED for that route, never 100% recall.
observed_gate_proposal.statistical_status: Even a numeric pass is DESCRIPTIVE_CANDIDATE_AVAILABILITY only; reviewer must assess episode support. No automatic H2 selection success or E2 authorization.

required_outputs: RUN_MANIFEST.json with source/code/spec/input/environment bindings and exact counts
CANDIDATES.csv.gz with every candidate tap, support/fallback role and lobe/port provenance; deterministic gzip mtime=0
LOBE_RECORDS.csv.gz once per waveform, with significant/unresolved/rejected/boundary peak reasons; deterministic gzip mtime=0
SUMMARY.json with per-route/per-channel/per-mode normal/wrong/large/unknown denominators and observed gate
FAILURE_LEDGER.json for any missing, malformed or failed inputs
technical_checks_before_run: Pure generator accepts only CIR and immutable config; no route/seed/GT/prior fields
Strongest-only taps are a subset of two-port union taps before any overflow eligibility
For valid raw frames the original raw tap is always retained; invalid raw frames preserve metadata and have empty pools. Two-port one-null cases remain supported.
Prominence/local amplitude definition is not power 30%
Local edge neighbors cannot expand to arbitrary whole-window candidates
Exact source pose/time joins and corpus counts enforced
Reference labels opened only in evaluator after generator outputs exist
Permuting reference/GT metadata cannot change generator outputs
No-real-data execution without root-owned frozen locks and reviewed entry gate
